query.esql:
FROM logs-corelight.conn*
| WHERE event.dataset  == "conn_agg"
| STATS count = COUNT()
| EVAL `Conn Aggregation` = CASE(count > 0, "Conn Agg Logs Available", "No Conn Agg Logs"),
    status = CASE(count > 0, 1, 0)
| KEEP `Conn Aggregation`, status

FROM logs-corelight.conn*
| WHERE event.dataset  == "conn_agg"
| STATS count = COUNT()
| EVAL `Conn Aggregation` = CASE(count > 0, "Conn Agg Logs Available", "No Conn Agg Logs"),
    status = CASE(count > 0, 1, 0)
| KEEP `Conn Aggregation`, status

FROM logs-corelight.conn*
| WHERE observer.hostname IS NOT NULL
  AND event.id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (
      (source.ip IN ("0.0.0.0", "255.255.255.255")
       OR destination.ip IN ("0.0.0.0", "255.255.255.255"))
      AND conn.local_resp == "true"
  )

| EVAL app =
    CASE(
      network.protocol IS NULL OR network.protocol == "",
      "unknown",
      network.protocol
    )

| STATS Total = COUNT(*) BY app
| SORT Total DESC
| LIMIT 15

query.esql:
FROM logs-corelight.conn*
| WHERE observer.hostname IS NOT NULL
  AND event.id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (source.ip IN ("0.0.0.0", "255.255.255.255") OR destination.ip IN ("0.0.0.0", "255.255.255.255") AND conn.local_resp == "true")
| STATS
    service = VALUES(network.protocol),
    bytes = SUM(source.ip_bytes)
  BY
    source.ip,
    destination.ip,
    network.direction
| WHERE network.direction == "outbound"
| KEEP source.ip, destination.ip, bytes, service
| SORT bytes DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-corelight.conn*
| WHERE observer.hostname IS NOT NULL
  AND event.id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (source.ip IN ("0.0.0.0", "255.255.255.255") OR destination.ip IN ("0.0.0.0", "255.255.255.255") AND conn.local_resp == "true")
| STATS
    service = VALUES(network.protocol),
    bytes = SUM(source.ip_bytes)
  BY
    source.ip,
    destination.ip,
    network.direction
| WHERE network.direction == "outbound"
| KEEP source.ip, destination.ip, bytes, service
| SORT bytes DESC
| LIMIT 10

query.esql:
FROM logs-corelight.conn*
| WHERE observer.hostname IS NOT NULL
  AND event.id IS NOT NULL
  AND event.duration IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (
      (source.ip IN ("0.0.0.0", "255.255.255.255")
       OR destination.ip IN ("0.0.0.0", "255.255.255.255"))
      AND conn.local_resp == "true"
  )
| STATS
    duration = AVG(event.duration),
    src_ip = VALUES(source.ip),
    dest_ip = VALUES(destination.ip),
    dest_port = VALUES(destination.port),
    service = VALUES(network.protocol)
  BY event.id
| EVAL Duration = ROUND(duration / 1000000000.0, 2)| SORT Duration DESC
| LIMIT 100
| RENAME
    event.id AS UID,
    src_ip AS `Source IP`,
    dest_ip AS `Destination IP`,
    dest_port AS `Destination Port`,
    service AS Service
| KEEP
    UID,
    Duration,
    `Source IP`,
    `Destination IP`,
    `Destination Port`,
    Service
